description: Lights, temperature, the timing of meals, access to a phone call, delay in medication - each defensible as operational and collectively something else.
energy_note: Nothing done to him. Several things not done.

aspect: The record is written by one party
description: Custody logs, timings and accounts of behaviour are produced by the people being complained about.

aspect: Complaint from custody is structurally weak
description: The complainant is in custody, frequently charged, and characterised in the same documents that would be the evidence.
energy_note: Complaining from inside, about the people holding the pen.

description: He asks three times. The third time: 'I'll see what we've got.' Nobody comes. At the handover the incoming officer brings one immediately, and is surprised he did not ask.
energy_note: Given instantly by the next shift.
